LC 48 1688-EC/AP
To amend Code Section 34-9-26 of the Official Code of Georgia Annotated, relating to
required notice regarding injured peace officers, so as to provide that the State Board of
Workers' Compensation shall provide for notice of eligibility for compensation to an injured
employee to his or her legal guardian; to amend Code Section 35-1-24 of the Official Code
of Georgia Annotated, relating to peace officers eligible for indemnification or disability
compensation and notifications, so as to provide that law enforcement agencies shall provide
notice of eligibility for compensation to an injured employee to his or her legal guardian; to
amend Part 1 of Article 5 of Chapter 9 of Title 45 of the Official Code of Georgia Annotated,
relating to the Georgia State Indemnification Fund, so as to provide for an application
window for eligible individuals incapacitated by organic brain damage sustained in the line
of duty on or before July 1, 2024; to provide for automatic repeal; to provide for related
matters; to provide for an effective date; to repeal conflicting laws; and for other purposes.
BE IT ENACTED BY THE GENERAL ASSEMBLY OF GEORGIA:
SECTION 1.
Code Section 34-9-26 of the Official Code of Georgia Annotated, relating to required notice
regarding injured peace officers, is amended by revising subsection (b) as follows:
LC 48 1688-EC/AP
"(b) In the event that the State Board of Workers' Compensation has reasonable cause to
believe that an injured employee is an eligible peace officer, the board shall notify the
